title: Runbook RB-112: Deploying the ledger service

headings.text: Runbook RB-112: Deploying the ledger service

key_sentences: This runbook describes how to release a new version of the ledger service to production.
It applies to scheduled releases only; emergency fixes follow runbook RB-090.
Check out the release tag and confirm that it was signed by the release manager.
The pool size must never exceed the connection limit agreed with the database team.
Run the query below fifteen minutes after the last pod has started.
Every settlement created in that period should be in the SETTLED or PENDING state.
Roll back without waiting for approval when any threshold in the table is crossed.

rows: Ledger on-call engineer, then the platform duty manager
40 minutes, of which 25 minutes are waiting for the rollout
kubectl rollout undo, then page the duty manager
Scale to 6 replicas; roll back if no change in 10 minutes
Replaced the manual canary with a rolling restart
Moved the verification query to the read replica

list_items.text: An approved change ticket with a release window of at least one hour.
Access to the production cluster through the bastion host:
a valid hardware key registered to your account;
A second engineer available to watch the dashboards during the rollout.
Announce the start of the release in the operations channel.
Restart the deployment and follow its progress:
pods are replaced one at a time;
each new pod must pass its readiness check before the next one starts.
Stop and go to section 4 if any pod fails to become ready within five minutes.
- Close the change ticket and record the release tag.
- Post the verification query output in the ticket.
- Hand the dashboards back to the on-call engineer.

code:
$ git fetch --tags origin
$ git checkout release/2026.10.2
$ ./scripts/verify-signature.sh release/2026.10.2

ledger:
  replicas: 4
  database:
    pool_size: 32
    statement_timeout_ms: 5000
  feature_flags:
    async_settlement: true

kubectl -n ledger rollout restart deployment/ledger-api
kubectl -n ledger rollout status deployment/ledger-api --timeout=10m

SELECT status, count(*)
  FROM settlements
 WHERE created_at > now() - interval '15 minutes'
 GROUP BY status;
notes: Two-page operations runbook. Running header: left and right blocks are separate furniture entries (listed once). Footer: left "Internal use only" (repeated, listed once) and right page-number line "Page 1 of 2" / "Page 2 of 2". Four code blocks in Courier New, given exactly with their indentation; the "$ " shell prompts are part of the visible code. Prerequisites list: CSS-drawn markers (circle at level 0, square at level 1). Procedure list in 3.3: CSS-drawn decimal at level 0 and lower-alpha at level 1 (markers not in list_items). The "After the rollout" box holds a list with TYPED "- " hyphen markers, inline (no hanging indent). Top panel: shaded 2-column key/value table without rules or header. Rollback table: rule under the header and between rows, cells of two lines (joined with one space); the Change history table uses the same style. Contacts table: no lines at all, italic header row.
